notes.claim: The monthly price is not a subscription; the wallet is metered per minute at monthly price / 730 / 60.
notes.quote: The monthly price is the rate; the wallet is metered per minute (the monthly price divided by 730 hours, divided by 60).

notes.claim: Billing uses reserved resources, not CPU utilisation.
notes.quote: Compute is priced from the instance’s `resources`

notes.claim: An idle but awake instance still pays compute.
notes.quote: An awake instance still pays compute even when its CPU is idle.

notes.claim: There is no monthly plan fee or seat charge on Cloud.
notes.quote: No monthly plan fee or seat charge

notes.claim: Whole minutes are billed at lifecycle transitions and at least hourly.
notes.quote: Whole minutes are billed at every lifecycle transition and at least hourly

notes.claim: Burstable is experimental, starts at $1/month, and publishes no shapes or rates.
notes.quote: `burstable` is an experimental instance type for low average CPU and RAM usage, with pricing starting at $1/month.

storage.model: persistent disk billed per GB-month while the instance exists, plus optional cold storage for parked instances

billedWhileStoppedOrSleeping.quote: `sleeping`, `stopped`, or `waking` | The disk rate alone: $0.09 per reserved GB per month.

coldStorage.quote: Parked in cold storage | $0.03 per GB per month, on the actual compressed bytes stored.

snapshots.value: No snapshot product. Nightly backups into seven rotating slots plus one on-demand backup; backups and restores are free.

retention.quote: An instance left suspended for 30 days is permanently deleted.

retention.value: Removed after 30 days, with an email a week before
retention.quote: An agent left asleep for 30 days is removed, and we email you a week before.

egress.detail: No egress or bandwidth rate appears on the pricing page or in the billing docs. The pricing page lists only compute and disk as metered.
egress.quote: Agent37 meters compute while the sandbox runs and disk while you keep it

other.quote: No monthly plan fee or seat charge

hermes.route: One-click managed hosting. Pick Hermes on the Personal product and it is provisioned with a dashboard, task board, web terminal, file browser, live desktop and messaging channels.
hermes.officialTemplateOrGuide: Yes: the Personal product and a Hermes hosting guide on the Agent 37 blog
hermes.manualSteps: None needed for the managed route. The API route is manual: create an instance from the agent37-hermes template, set model/env, then send messages to the instance URL.
hermes.nonCoderFromDashboard: Yes. Sign-up needs no card on the free plan; the agent is configured and driven from the browser.
